item.title: Whanganui study aims to tackle growing mate wareware concerns among Māori - AWA FM
item.description: A major new study into mate wareware is set to roll out across Whanganui, aiming to better understand how dementia is affecting kaumātua and their whānau.

item.title: The sweet spot: Inside an iwi’s fast-growing berry enterprise - AWA FM
item.description: Ngā Wairiki-Ngāti Apa say patience and a willingness to learn are paying off, as it lifts strawberry yields from 240 grams per plant in its first year to 840 grams last season.

item.title: Te Hou Farms: Big push to boost dairy output - AWA FM
item.description: Māori-owned Te Hou Farms near Bulls is set to lift its dairy production by around 60 percent within three seasons.

item.title: Anxiety rises over Ruapehu water plan - and the hit on household pockets - AWA FM
item.description: Ruapehu mayor Weston Kirton says the district must proceed with its planned two-council water organisation with Whanganui, despite fears that household charges could rise by 92 percent within eight years.

item.title: $130m and counting – but is it enough? The stark post-settlement reality facing iwi - AWA FM
item.description: Since settling its treaty claims in 2011 with an asset base of just under $30 million, Ngā Wairiki-Ngāti Apa has quadrupled its redress pūtea to nearly $130 million.

item.title: Ngāti Rangi launches Te Kōpae to hold Crown agencies to settlement commitments - AWA FM
item.description: Ngāti Rangi has launched a new framework with 11 government agencies to advance relationships promised under its Treaty settlement with the Crown.

item.title: Troubled pilot academy: Mayor backs review after $11m loss revealed - AWA FM
item.description: Whanganui District Council could face scrutiny over its decade-long investment in the troubled New Zealand International Commercial Pilot Academy.

item.title: Government backs Chateau Tongariro restoration as mayor welcomes ‘win’ - AWA FM
item.description: The Government has moved to back the restoration of the Chateau Tongariro, launching a formal process to find private operators to revive the historic hotel.

item.title: Kiwi come home: Taonga manu return to ancestral forest - AWA FM
item.description: Ngāti Rangi has welcomed home 10 taonga Western Brown Kiwi, releasing the juvenile birds into forest at Rotokura and Rangataua.

item.title: Whanganui council faces criticism after $62k logo spend - AWA FM
item.description: Questions are being raised about Whanganui District Council’s $62,000 logo redesign, with ratepayer advocates saying the full cost of the rebrand remains unknown and key details around the process are missing.

item.title: ‘Hamstrung’ council sets wishlist for tougher dog control powers - AWA FM
item.description: Ruapehu mayor Weston Kirton is calling for sweeping changes to dog control laws, including stronger powers.

item.title: Decline in dog attacks: Whanganui pushes steady approach as dog laws reviewed - AWA FM
item.description: Whanganui officials say current dog control measures are working effectively, as the Government considers changes to national legislation.
